oneOf.description: Stateful facade resource opened through a feature-family surface: memory namespaces, workflows, journals, delivery ledgers, run stores, MCP/A2A clients, … The owning Rust service keeps the business state; the handle only carries addressing and lifecycle.

WireHandle.description:
Opaque handle to a framework object: non-empty domain id + generation.

Ids are strings assigned by the framework authority; the SDK never interprets their content, never exposes memory addresses, and never reuses an id across kinds.

generation.description: Monotonic generation of the owning Host; incremented across restarts so pre-restart handles fail as stale instead of rebinding.

id.description: Non-empty domain identity assigned by the framework.

handle.description: Handle the error refers to, when applicable.

operation.description: Domain operation identity (e.g. `run/start`), independent from any JSON-RPC request id.

facade.description: Typed facade-operation failure facts (unknown operation, signature mismatch, wrong receiver/type, missing feature, resource bound).

fields.description: Bounded key/value facts; values are strings, never raw payloads.

ExtensionErrorCode.description: Stable extension error codes. Codes are closed: reusing a retired code for a different meaning is a breaking protocol change (design §18).

oneOf.description: Peer does not speak a compatible ACP wire protocol version.
Peer's `_echo_agent` extension protocol version is incompatible.
Extension contract/source digest mismatch.
Required extension capability missing or unsupported.
Malformed request (structure, method usage, ordering).
Semantically invalid configuration.
Semantically invalid value (scalars, paths, payload shapes).
Operation requires a feature the Host was not compiled with.
Handle generation no longer matches the live object.
Handle refers to an object that has been closed/destroyed.
Framework returned a typed domain error.
Registered extension rejected the invocation.
Registered extension failed while executing.
Extension invocation exceeded its deadline.
Extension's SDK connection is gone.
Invocation conflicts with an exclusive in-flight callback of the same registration (re-entrant mutation). Re-entry returns this typed conflict instead of waiting for the holder (design §12.3).
Operation was cancelled; framework terminal state remains authoritative.
Host is shutting down and refuses new work.
Host process exited before the operation settled.
Consumer fell below the retained watermark.
Replay is unavailable for the requested window.
Payload exceeds the negotiated bound.
Payload violates the extension serialization contract.

FacadeFailureDetail.description: Typed facts for facade-operation admission failures. Every field is a bounded identity — never a raw payload — so language SDKs can map the failure precisely without parsing the message (design §10.6).

expected_type.description: Expected wire type of the offending value.

operation.description: Exact operation identity the request named (e.g. the canonical source identity of a facade invocation).

required_feature.description: Root leaf feature the operation requires.

resource.description: Facade resource identity the failure refers to.

signature_digest.description: Signature digest the request claimed, when a digest was supplied.
